target: Make embedded-audit proofs under proof/pr_merge/** visible to deterministic validation, so that a proof the canonical schema rejects cannot pass CI unexamined — without converting unrelated legacy proof debt into an unbounded repair campaign.
invariants: SCOPE: this packet exists because two independent filters both skip proof/pr_merge/**. proof/.validator_scope.json sets include_patterns to proof/TP-DMX-*/PROOF.json with default_when_unmatched: skip_with_warning, and the pre-commit proof hook matches only ^proof/[^/]+/PROOF\.json$. Every proof under proof/pr_merge/** is therefore unvalidated by both the scanned sweep and pre-commit.

EVIDENCE: this is a confirmed defect, not a hypothesis. PR #1165 published a proof whose report_path violated the trusted schema pattern; a direct scripts/audit/validate_audit_proof.py run rejected it while CI stayed green, because neither filter looked.

NOT ALREADY FIXED: repairing scripts/audit/local_audit_acceptance.py to execute the canonical schema (TP-DMX-AUDIT-AGY-GEMINI31-APPROVAL-001-REPAIR-001, step R07) closes the signed local-attestation route only. It does not make the deterministic sweep or pre-commit look at proof/pr_merge/**. Do not report this packet's work as done by that repair.

BOUNDED BLAST RADIUS: widening validator scope will surface pre-existing nonconformant proofs. Enumerate them first and classify each as REPAIR / QUARANTINE / DOCUMENTED-LEGACY before changing any default. A scope widening that turns CI red across unrelated history is a failed execution of this packet, not a success.
NO SILENT SKIPS: default_when_unmatched: skip_with_warning is the mechanism that produced the false green. Any retained skip must be an explicit, enumerated, reviewed entry — never a fallthrough.
FAIL CLOSED: an unmatched or unreadable proof must not be reported as PASS. A sweep that validates nothing must not exit 0 with a green summary.

NO GATE WEAKENING: this packet must not weaken signature verification, allowed-signers trust, namespace binding, repository or PR identity, audited-head ancestry, proof-only successor closure, passing-verdict policy, or PR Steward semantics.

SINGLE POLICY ENGINE: schemas/proof/embedded_audit.schema.json remains the only authority on embedded_audit shape. Do not introduce a second hand-written validator; extend coverage, not the number of implementations.
